summary: xAI released Grok Imagine Image 2.0, an updated image generation and editing model available as the new Quality Mode on Grok's consumer apps and via the API as grok-imagine-image-2.0.

practices.reason: The model shows stated gains in instruction-following precision, typography/layout planning, and consistency across edits, relevant to teams building image-generation features but evidenced mainly by the lab's own arena ranking.
practices.quote: 2.0 follows instructions closely, down to the details. It plans typography and layout the way a designer would, so dense, multi-part visuals hold together and small text comes out sharp.

practices.reason: The lab cites an external leaderboard ranking, which is a transferable benchmark but not a novel eval method a team would build from.
practices.quote: It ranks second in the world in both text-to-image generation and image editing.

practices.reason: A new model identifier is exposed in the API, requiring teams to update model references if they want to adopt it.
practices.quote: In the API Image 2.0 is available in the API as grok-imagine-image-2.0 .
